Proposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments Information and Recommendation Report for 125 Central Avenue
Recommendation:
That:
Council approves the proposed amendment to the Town’s Official Plan as detailed in Report PBBS-49-2026 for the land known as 125 Central Avenue; and further
That:
Council approves the proposed amendment to the Town’s Zoning By-law 129-90 as detailed in Report PBBS-49-2026 for the land known as 125 Central Avenue; and further
That:
Council directs that a Holding Provision under Section 36(1) of the Planning Act, R.S.O. 1990 be applied to the subject lands and not be removed until such time as:
A Stage 1 Archaeological Assessment, and any subsequent archaeological assessments (Stage 2–4), as may be required, have been completed by a licensed archaeologist in accordance with provincial standards and guidelines, for lands identified as being within an Area of Archaeological Potential.
Any required archaeological assessment(s) have been submitted to and reviewed by the Ministry of Citizenship and Multiculturalism, and written confirmation has been provided that the assessment(s) have been entered into the Ontario Public Register of Archaeological Reports.
Where archaeological resources are identified, significant archaeological resources have been conserved, or the lands have been appropriately investigated and cleared in accordance with provincial requirements, to the satisfaction of the Town’s Manager of Policy and Community Planning, or their delegate.
An Affordable Housing Community Improvement Plan Agreement between the Owner and the Town has been executed, to the satisfaction of the Town’s Manager of Policy and Community Planning, or their delegate.
That:
Council directs staff to submit the necessary by-laws.
